title: 👑 Version 1.2.0 • VIP Lifetime Pass is Here!
message: Big update, Station Master! You can now play without ads forever with the new VIP Lifetime Pass. Pay only once, no subscription. Free players can still enjoy everything by watching ads.
points: 👑 VIP Lifetime Pass: Pay once and remove all ads forever.
⚡ VIP Perks: Get 2X rewards instantly, run Premier trains without ads and build daily trains without waiting.
🎁 Secret Scratch Card: Scratch the golden card to unlock a special lower price. It lasts only 1 hour!
📺 Smoother Ads: If an ad is still loading, the game now waits for it instead of showing an error.
⭐ Rate Us: Share your rating right inside the game, no need to leave.
📱 More from DevDuo: Discover more of our apps and games.
🛠️ Small fixes and improvements for a smoother game.

title: 🚆 Version 1.1.0 • Cheaper Upgrades & More!
message: Big news, Station Master! Upgrades are now cheaper, so you can grow your station faster. The game will also tell you when new updates arrive.
points: 💰 Cheaper Upgrades: Shunters, revenue boosts, yard lines and station modules now cost less.
🔔 Update Alerts: Get notified when a new version is ready and see what's new.
📱 DevDuo Apps Hub: Find more apps and games from DevDuo in Station Settings.
🛠️ Small fixes and improvements for a smoother game.

title: 🚉 Version 1.0.1 • First Release
message: Welcome to Indian Rail Shunter! Run your own busy Indian railway station.
points: 🚂 Shunt coaches between the yard and platforms.
🚆 Receive trains, swap engines and send them on their way.
📦 Watch freight trains fly through the corridor.
🎁 Collect daily rewards and upgrade your station.
